opening: Dietary fiber intake is associated with improved response to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) in melanoma. The phase II Diet and Immune Effects Trial (DIET, NCT04645680) was conducted in melanoma patients receiving ICB testing the effects of a high fiber diet intervention vs. healthy control diet. Our early results revealed that the high fiber diet intervention is feasible with promising improvements in treatment outcomes.
